title: The Ultimate Aang & Korra Blu-Ray Collection $42.01 + Delivery ($0 Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon US via AU
body:
Deal: The Ultimate Aang & Korra Blu-Ray Collection $42.01 + Delivery ($0 Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon US via AU

[zander95] Have this set. It is region free, but my set had an error with the Korra set, where it was missing 1 disc and 2x copies of another
[justtoreply] This is a good deal. That's about what I paid for korrra by itself. And aang was like $70
[CartoonPizza] Just regular blu-ray.
A 4K official release of these is very unlikely.
[Circly] Post above says it's region free though.
[mr_me450] It’s region free, it will play in all AU players.
[CptnObvious] Can't wait for Seven Havens to come out.
[Uncle Roger] Idk man, that trailer looked off. Did you enjoy the aang movie?
[CptnObvious] Yeh i did. I am hoping seven havens go back to the mystic roots of avatar lore. Plus I like protagonist being a kid who kicks ass again.
[Pootossmonke24] Didn't look great tbh and the story of the movie left a lot to be desired. I'm hopeful but the avatar also being like 8 years old is a bit off too. Only so much you can do with a character so young
[bootlace] Just watched The Last Airbender for the first time last month. Amaaaaaaazing. I get the hype.
Watching Korra now, into season 3. Loving it, too.
[Haulien] Have seen some reviews with missing discs, duplicated discs, or discs not working in this set.
Seems it only affects a very small subset of sets but be sure to test every disc before your return window closes!
[quarrymaster] Interesting my honey extension suggested it was down to $36.11 just a few weeks ago.
[Bard] Thanks, got this and the Cowboy Bebop set for the discount. Always thought about getting back into watching Avatar and Korra.
